### `PickerOptions` {#pickeroptions}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The heading displayed at the top of the picker modal. Use a clear, descriptive title that tells merchants what they're selecting. |
| `multiple?` | <code v-pre>boolean &#124; number</code> | The selection mode for the picker. Pass `true` to allow unlimited selections, `false` for single-item selection only, or a number to set a maximum selection limit (for example, `3` allows up to three items). Por defecto: `false` |
| `headers?` | <code v-pre><a href="#header">Header</a>[]</code> | The column headers for the picker table. Define headers to label and organize the data columns displayed for each item. The header order determines the column layout. |
| `items` | <code v-pre><a href="#pickeritem">PickerItem</a>[]</code> | The list of items that merchants can select from. Each item appears as a row in the picker table. |

Se usa en: [`PickerApi`](#pickerapi)

### `Header` {#header}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The label text displayed at the top of the table column. Use clear, concise labels that describe the data in that column (for example, "Price", "Status", "Last Updated"). |
| `type?` | <code v-pre>"string" &#124; "number"</code> | The data type that controls column formatting and text alignment. Use `'number'` for currency, prices, or numeric values (displays right-aligned), or `'string'` for text content (displays left-aligned). Por defecto: `'string'` |

Se usa en: [`PickerOptions`](#pickeroptions)

### `PickerItem` {#pickeritem}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The unique identifier for this item. This ID is returned in the selection array when the merchant selects this item. Use an ID that helps you identify the item in your system (for example, template IDs, review IDs, or custom option keys). |
| `heading` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The primary text displayed in the first column. This is typically the item's name or title and is the most prominent text in the row. |
| `data?` | <code v-pre><a href="#datapoint">DataPoint</a>[]</code> | Additional data displayed in subsequent columns after the heading. Each value appears in its own column, and the order must match the `headers` array. For example, if headers are `["Price", "Status"]`, then data would be `[19.99, "Active"]`. |
| `disabled?` | <code v-pre>boolean</code> | Whether the item can be selected. When `true`, the item is disabled and can't be selected. Disabled items appear grayed out. Use this for items that are unavailable or don't meet selection criteria. Por defecto: `false` |
| `selected?` | <code v-pre>boolean</code> | Whether the item is preselected when the picker opens. When `true`, the item appears selected by default. Merchants can still deselect preselected items. Use this to show current selections or suggest default choices. |
| `badges?` | <code v-pre><a href="#badge">Badge</a>[]</code> | Status or context badges displayed next to the heading in the first column. Use badges to highlight item state, completion status, or other important attributes (for example, "Draft", "Published", "Incomplete"). |
| `thumbnail?` | <code v-pre>{ url: string; }</code> | A small preview image or icon displayed at the start of the row. Thumbnails help merchants visually identify items at a glance. Provide a URL to the image file. |

Se usa en: [`PickerOptions`](#pickeroptions)

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `tone?` | <code v-pre><a href="#tone">Tone</a></code> | The visual tone indicating status or importance. Choose a tone that matches the badge's meaning. |
| `progress?` | <code v-pre><a href="#progress">Progress</a></code> | The progress indicator for the badge. Use this to show completion status for items that have progress states. |

## `ResourcePickerApi` {#resourcepickerapi}

```ts
type ResourcePickerApi = <ResourceType extends keyof ResourceTypes = keyof ResourceTypes>(options: ResourcePickerOptions<ResourceType>) => Promise<SelectPayload<ResourceType> | undefined>;
```

Referencias: [`ResourcePickerOptions`](#resourcepickeroptions), [`ResourceTypes`](#resourcetypes), [`SelectPayload`](#selectpayload)

Se usa en: [useAppBridge()](/es/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/es/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)

### `ResourcePickerOptions` {#resourcepickeroptions}

Parámetros de tipo: <code v-pre>ResourceType extends keyof <a href="#resourcetypes">ResourceTypes</a> = keyof <a href="#resourcetypes">ResourceTypes</a></code>

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | <code v-pre>ResourceType</code> | The type of Shopify resource to select: `'product'` for products, `'variant'` for specific product variants, or `'collection'` for collections. This determines what appears in the picker and what data structure is returned. |
| `action?` | <code v-pre>"add" &#124; "select"</code> | The action verb that appears in the title as the primary action of the resource picker. "Add" prompts merchants that they are appending to an existing list, while "select" they'll choose a resource for a specific purpose or replacing selections. Por defecto: `'add'` |
| `filter?` | <code v-pre><a href="#filters">Filters</a></code> | Filtering options that control which resources appear in the resourcepicker. Use filters to restrict resources by publication status, include or exclude variants, or apply custom search criteria. This helps merchants find relevant items faster. |
| `multiple?` | <code v-pre>boolean &#124; number</code> | Whether to allow selecting multiple items of a specific type. If a number is provided, limit selections to that maximum. When `type` is `'product'`, merchants can still select multiple variants from a single product even when `multiple` is `false`. Por defecto: `false` |
| `query?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | Initial GraphQL search query for filtering resources available in the resource picker. See [search syntax](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/search-syntax) for more information. This is displayed in the search bar when the picker is opened and can be edited by users. For most use cases, you should use the `filter.query` option instead which doesn't show the query in the UI. Por defecto: `''` |
| `selectionIds?` | <code v-pre><a href="#baseresource">BaseResource</a>[]</code> | Resources that should be preselected when the picker is opened. Use this for edit workflows to show what products are already in a bundle, collection, or promotional set. Merchants can see current selections and modify them before confirming. Por defecto: `[]` |

Se usa en: [`ResourcePickerApi`](#resourcepickerapi)

### `Filters` {#filters}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hidden?` | <code v-pre>boolean</code> | Whether to show hidden resources, referring to products that are not published on any sales channels. Por defecto: `true` |
| `variants?` | <code v-pre>boolean</code> | Whether to show product variants. Only applies to the Product resource type picker. Por defecto: `true` |
| `draft?` | <code v-pre>boolean &#124; undefined</code> | Whether to show [draft products](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/details?shpxid=70af7d87-E0F2-4973-8B09-B972AAF0ADFD#product-availability). Only applies to the Product resource type picker. Setting this to undefined will show a badge on draft products. Por defecto: `true` |
| `archived?` | <code v-pre>boolean &#124; undefined</code> | Whether to show [archived products](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/details?shpxid=70af7d87-E0F2-4973-8B09-B972AAF0ADFD#product-availability). Only applies to the Product resource type picker. Setting this to undefined will show a badge on draft products. Por defecto: `true` |
| `query?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | GraphQL initial search query for filtering resources available in the picker. See [search syntax](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/search-syntax) for more information. This query is not visible to merchants and runs server-side. Use it to programmatically restrict results (for example, `vendor:Acme`) without exposing the filter logic. |

Se usa en: [`ResourcePickerOptions`](#resourcepickeroptions)

## `ReviewsApi` {#reviewsapi}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `request()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#reviewrequestresponse">ReviewRequestResponse</a>&gt;</code> | Requests an app review modal. The modal only displays if rate limits and eligibility conditions are met. Returns a Promise that resolves to a response object with `success`, `code`, and `message` properties indicating whether the modal was shown and, if not, the reason why. |

Se usa en: [useAppBridge()](/es/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/es/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)

### `ReviewRequestResponse` {#reviewrequestresponse}

```ts
type ReviewRequestResponse = ReviewRequestSuccessResponse | ReviewRequestDeclinedResponse;
```

Referencias: [`ReviewRequestDeclinedResponse`](#reviewrequestdeclinedresponse), [`ReviewRequestSuccessResponse`](#reviewrequestsuccessresponse)

Se usa en: [`ReviewsApi`](#reviewsapi)

### `ReviewRequestDeclinedResponse` {#reviewrequestdeclinedresponse}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `success` | <code v-pre>false</code> | Indicates the review modal was not displayed. |
| `code` | <code v-pre><a href="#reviewrequestdeclinedcode">ReviewRequestDeclinedCode</a></code> | A code identifying why the modal was not displayed, such as rate limits or merchant eligibility. |
| `message` | <code v-pre>string</code> | A human-readable message explaining why the modal was not displayed. |

Se usa en: [`ReviewRequestResponse`](#reviewrequestresponse)

### `ReviewRequestSuccessResponse` {#reviewrequestsuccessresponse}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `success` | <code v-pre>true</code> | Indicates the review modal was successfully displayed. |
| `code` | <code v-pre>"success"</code> | The response code. Always `'success'` for a successful request. |
| `message` | <code v-pre>"Review modal shown successfully"</code> | A human-readable message confirming the modal was shown. |

Se usa en: [`ReviewRequestResponse`](#reviewrequestresponse)

```ts
type ReviewRequestDeclinedCode = "mobile-app" | "already-reviewed" | "annual-limit-reached" | "cooldown-period" | "merchant-ineligible" | "recently-installed" | "already-open" | "open-in-progress" | "cancelled";
```

Se usa en: [`ReviewRequestDeclinedResponse`](#reviewrequestdeclinedresponse)

## `SaveBarApi` {#savebarapi}

Extiende: <code v-pre>Required&lt;<a href="#_savebarapi">_SaveBarApi</a>&gt;</code>

Se usa en: [useAppBridge()](/es/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/es/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)

### `_SaveBarApi` {#_savebarapi}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `show?()` | <code v-pre>(id: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Displays the save bar to indicate unsaved changes. Call this when you want to prompt the merchant to save. |
| `hide?()` | <code v-pre>(id: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Hides the save bar. Call this after the merchant saves or discards their changes. |
| `toggle?()` | <code v-pre>(id: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Toggles save bar visibility between shown and hidden states. |
| `leaveConfirmation?()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Prompts the merchant to confirm before leaving the page when there are unsaved changes. The promise resolves when the merchant confirms or when no save bar is visible. Use this before programmatic navigation (for example, using `window.location` or custom routing) to prevent accidental data loss. |

Se usa en: [`SaveBarApi`](#savebarapi)

## `SidekickApi` {#sidekickapi}

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isEnabled()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</code> | Checks whether Sidekick is available to the app on this store. Call it before showing a launch entry point. |
| `isOpen()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</code> | Checks whether the Sidekick panel is open. |
| `open()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Opens the Sidekick panel without sending a prompt. |
| `launch()` | <code v-pre>(request: <a href="#sidekicklaunchrequest">SidekickLaunchRequest</a> &#124; string) =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#sidekickconversation">SidekickConversation</a>&gt;</code> | Opens Sidekick and sends `message` as the merchant's prompt. A string is shorthand for `{message}`. Call it from a merchant action, such as a button click. Shopify screens the prompt first and rejects with an error whose message starts with `sidekick.launch:` when it refuses to send it. |

Se usa en: [useAppBridge()](/es/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](/es/app-bridge/types/#shopifyglobal)

A request to start a Sidekick conversation from your app.

| Miembro | Tipo | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The prompt to send to Sidekick as the merchant's message. Required, and must be non-empty after trimming. Shopify trims surrounding whitespace and rejects a prompt longer than a merchant could type into Sidekick. |
